description: G.B. Piyadasa v. P.W. Dayasena G.B. Piyadasa v. P.W. Dayasena View More before Hon. A.W. Abdus Salam, J.
parties: G.B. Piyadasa v. P.W. Dayasena G.B. Piyadasa v. P.W. Dayasena View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court judgement dismissing his action for declaration of title and ejectment. Rei vindicatio action requires establishment of balance of probabilities, both the identity of corpus and title. Held - Deeds relied upon did not establish title to entirety of land in suit. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
